content: The Bus Mirroring module shall poll the status of each active LIN source bus by cyclically calling LinIf_GetTrcvMode from the Mirror_Main- Function . If the returned TransceiverModePtr is LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_NOR- MAL , the reported LIN source bus state shall be set to online, otherwise to offline.
